title: Bounded iteration
summary: Repair against external feedback within explicit limits.
useWhen: An external rubric or check can identify improvement.
Focused repairs can address stable failing checks.
avoidWhen: No useful acceptance or progress indicator exists.
contract: Requires adversarial verification in the bundled executor.
Set maximum rounds and calls before launch.
Stop on acceptance, repeated failing check IDs or the ceiling.
example: Repair a unit for at most two rounds and stop if the same external failure repeats.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  W[Work] --> E[External evaluation]
  E -->|Pass| D[Done]
  E -->|Fail within limit| R[Focused repair]
  R --> E
  E -->|Repeated / limit| S[Stop]
